newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank market quiet at year-end.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank market quiet at year-end.

text.p: Egyptian private bankers said they again avoided the interbank pound market on Tuesday, which marked the beginning of the state's fiscal year.
The Central Bank and state-banks were closed on Tuesday.
Only one banker quoted tomorrow next rate at nine percent. Overnight rates were quoted on Monday at 8-3/4 to 9-1/8 percent.
One-week rates were between 9-1/8 and 9-1/4 percent on Monay.
Most active bankers said they had squared their positions a few days ago and that there was little demand for the pound.
